evidence: Source-level Pass. The public ask expressly requires keyboard and narrow-screen usability and allows one colour scheme (task/instruction.md:7; environment/instructions/ui.md:3-11). The render gate requires an authored Run and observed calculated preview/console (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25); the constraints gate requires UI Save and independent-context readback (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-27). The functional protocol requires six-second idle intervals followed by actual preview click and key/input actions (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:134-160), pending-timer and Stop observations (:163-182), Auto-run/debounce toggles (:388-404), and a ten-second callback observation (:448-460). Polish requires actual keyboard-only navigation (tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:43-51) and usable editor/preview/console at roughly 390x844 (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23). Visual requires a desktop/mobile comparison of at least two same surfaces (tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:17-20,42-43; judge.toml:99). Thus a first-paint mock cannot earn these behavior outcomes. A one-theme app with responsive tabs/scrolling and live handlers remains conforming; no unasked theme toggle is imposed. Indexed scripted reference evidence has 77/77 current hashes matching, includes S03/S04/S17/S36 timed actions and a 390x844 mobile scroll capture (per-row-review/evidence/34/source-and-artifact-audit.json). These scripted probes do not prove that an exact-current configured judge followed the directions. Raw index explicitly reports no exact-current Oracle, Luna, visual Likert or full judge timing result; this is the remaining risk.
